And what else is there I can do? So I say “ok” and accept it. Accept the circumstance, or the calling, or the end, the uncertainty, hardship, frustration of it all.  Things outside my control, but that obviously affect me, so what more is there to do or say than grin and bear it?  There’s a reason I have to embrace it this way, a purpose for why I’m forced into this position. Somehow life finds a Wah to turn me into a carnival contortionist and twists my soul to fit this path I’m on.  Just trying to take it in, to take it on, to get through it.
